verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a SaaS code-review service like Greptile, but the evidence pack documents no data-export feature, no bulk download of reviews, learned preferences or custom rules, and no open-format exit path. Adjacent items (greptile.json config stored in the repo, MCP access to PR comments and patterns, self-hosting with logs kept on customer servers) are about configuration, integration or deployment, not exporting all user data and leaving.
